name: rediarize-new-speaker
why: A fourth voice appears in the re-run — someone who was not diarized out the first time — and it happens to share 1200 ms with a named prior speaker. That is below the 2000 ms identity floor, so it must mint a NEW speaker rather than inherit the name. A wrong identity carry-over is worse than an extra speaker row: a human already put a real name on the old one, and from the transcript the mistake is invisible.

expect.note: SPEAKER_03 overlaps spk-interviewer by 1200 ms, under the max(2000 ms, 0.2 x min) floor.
